name: pyvar-mcp
description: MCP server exposing all 385 pyvar.com risk functions (VaR, credit, derivatives, liquidity, operational risk, portfolio analytics, ALM, regulatory) as Claude Code tools, via the live pyvar API

pyvar_api_key.title: pyvar API key
pyvar_api_key.description: Optional. Leave empty to try 30 functions with no sign-up (a few calls a day). For every function and higher limits: sign in at https://www.pyvar.com#get-api-key, create a pyvar API key (starts with pyvar_) on the dashboard; it lasts a year and can be revoked there.
